{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Web.Scotty
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Crypto.MAC.HMAC (hmac, HMAC(..))
import Crypto.Hash.Algorithms (SHA256)
import Data.ByteArray (convert)
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Data.Bits (xor, (.|.))
import Control.Monad (when)
import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO)
import System.Clock
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)

type TokenStore = Map Text ByteString

-- | Master key is loaded from the environment, not hardcoded.
loadMasterKey :: IO ByteString
loadMasterKey = do
  mk <- lookupEnv "TOKEN_MASTER_KEY"
  case mk of
    Just k | not (null k) -> return (BC.pack k)
    _ -> error "TOKEN_MASTER_KEY environment variable must be set"

-- | Derive a fixed-length token digest using HMAC-SHA256 over the full token.
-- This replaces the previous insecure ECB encryption with 16-byte truncation,
-- eliminating both the ECB pattern-leak and the token-collision auth bypass.
encryptTokenWith :: ByteString -> ByteString -> ByteString
encryptTokenWith key plaintext =
  convert (hmac key plaintext :: HMAC SHA256)

-- | Constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks
constantTimeCompare :: ByteString -> ByteString -> Bool
constantTimeCompare a b
  | BS.length a /= BS.length b = False
  | otherwise = go 0 0
  where
    len = BS.length a
    go :: Int -> Word8 -> Bool
    go i acc
      | i >= len  = acc == 0
      | otherwise =
          let diff = BS.index a i `xor` BS.index b i
          in go (i + 1) (acc .|. diff)

-- | Verify an API token against stored encrypted tokens
verifyToken :: ByteString -> TokenStore -> Text -> ByteString -> IO Bool
verifyToken key store userId suppliedToken = do
  case Map.lookup userId store of
    Nothing -> do
      let _ = constantTimeCompare (encryptTokenWith key "dummy_placeholder") (encryptTokenWith key suppliedToken)
      return False
    Just storedEncrypted -> do
      let suppliedEncrypted = encryptTokenWith key suppliedToken
      return $ constantTimeCompare storedEncrypted suppliedEncrypted

-- | Rate-limited authentication endpoint
authenticate :: ByteString -> IORef TokenStore -> IORef (Map Text TimeSpec) -> ActionM ()
authenticate key storeRef rateLimitRef = do
  uid <- param "user_id"
  token <- param "token"
  store <- liftIO $ readIORef storeRef
  rateMap <- liftIO $ readIORef rateLimitRef
  now <- liftIO $ getTime Monotonic
  let lastAttempt = Map.lookup uid rateMap
  case lastAttempt of
    Just t | diffTimeSpec now t < TimeSpec 1 0 -> do
      status status429
      text "Rate limited"
    _ -> do
      liftIO $ modifyIORef' rateLimitRef (Map.insert uid now)
      result <- liftIO $ verifyToken key store uid (TE.encodeUtf8 token)
      if result
        then json (Map.fromList [("status" :: Text, "authenticated" :: Text)])
        else do
          status status401
          text "Invalid credentials"

-- | Admin endpoint to provision tokens
provisionToken :: ByteString -> IORef TokenStore -> ActionM ()
provisionToken key storeRef = do
  uid <- param "user_id"
  token <- param "token"
  let encrypted = encryptTokenWith key (TE.encodeUtf8 token)
  liftIO $ modifyIORef' storeRef (Map.insert uid encrypted)
  json (Map.fromList [("status" :: Text, "provisioned" :: Text)])

-- | Health check with timing diagnostics
healthCheck :: IORef TokenStore -> ActionM ()
healthCheck storeRef = do
  store <- liftIO $ readIORef storeRef
  let userCount = Map.size store
  json (Map.fromList [("users" :: Text, T.pack (show userCount))])

main :: IO ()
main = do
  key <- loadMasterKey
  storeRef <- newIORef Map.empty
  rateLimitRef <- newIORef Map.empty
  scotty 3000 $ do
    post "/auth" $ authenticate key storeRef rateLimitRef
    post "/provision" $ provisionToken key storeRef
    get "/health" $ healthCheck storeRef
